title_en: UNIT/BAR-CAFE FOR SALE ON DIBRA STREET!

The environment is located in a new building on the 0th floor with a veranda. It is located in an area with new residential complexes near the main roads and institutions in the area. This position makes it ideal for a regular and stable clientele. The bar is fully invested and in working condition, sold as in the photo. The environment is ready for anyone who wants to exercise bar-caffè activity. The environment has a stable clientele and a contemporary investment. The space can be adapted very easily for other business activities based on the buyer's interest. The environment also has two accesses both from the front and from behind the building, this makes it even more favorable for its visibility.
